alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued August 9 at 1:04AM PDT until August 10 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with highs of 110 to 115 in the
Las Vegas Valley, Pahrump, Moapa Valley, and the Colorado River
Valley, and up to 120 in Death Valley. Warm overnight temperatures
will result in little relief overnight.

* WHERE...Lake Mohave, Lake Mead, Lower Colorado River Valley / Lake
Havasu, Death Valley National Park, Northeast Clark County, Western
Clark and Southern Nye County, and Las Vegas Valley.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT /8 PM MST/ Monday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
